senses.gloss:
शफ mn. (-फः-फं)
 1. A hoof in general.
 2. The root of a tree.
 3. The hoof
of a horse.
 E. शम् to be tranquil, aff. अच्, the final changed to फ ।

शफर mf. (-रः-री) A small fish, (Cyprinus Sophore, HAM.)
 E. शफ a hoof,
रा to give, (to resemble,) aff. क । “पुंँटीमाछ ।”

सफर mf. (-रः-री) A small glistening fish, commonly Punthi, a sort of
carp, (Cyphores-ophore, HAM:) see शफर ।

शफराधिप m. (-पः) The Ilisha fish, (Ilisha clupanodon.)
 E. शफर a carp, अधिप chief.

शाफरिक m. (-कः) A fisherman.
 E. शफर a kind of fish, put for any, and ठक् aff.

सफल mfn. (-लः-ला or ली-लं) Productive, fruitful, bearing fruit, yielding
a profit, &c.
 E. स for सह with, and फल fruit.

साफल्य n. (-ल्यं)
 1. Productiveness, fruitfulness.
 2. Advantage.
 3. Success.
 E. स with, फल fruit, ष्यञ् aff.
